text: y，Shanghai 200003，China;2． College of Chemical and Biological Engineering，Yichun University，Jiangxi Yichun 336003，China;3． School of Pharmacy，Shenyang Pharmaceutical University，Liaoning Shenyang 110015，China)ABSTRACT: Fructus schisandrae is the dried ripe fruit of Schisandra chinensis ( Turcz． ) Baill and Schisandra sphenanthera Rehd． et Wils.Its preparations have been widely applied in clinical practice.In this paper，the interaction mechanism between Fructus schisandrae and its preparations with other drugs is briefly introduced based on a summary of literatures in recent years，and the study can provide a reliable reference for their clinical application．五味子为中医药常用及名贵药材，始载于神农本草经，列为上品，有 “北五味子 ” ( Schisandraechinensis fructus ) 和 “ 南五味子 ” ( Schisandraesphenantherae) 之分，然而，由于南五味子价格低廉且与北五味子具有相似的特性，民间常将二者有意或无意的混用作为滋补强壮药，但南北五味子两种生药的主要活性成分含量、药理作用以及药材质量等方面存在较大差异性，自 2000 年版 《中国药典》起，将五味子分别收载为五味子和南五味子两个品种［1-2］。
